title:
What Really Drives Agri‐Environment‐Climate Measures' Adoption? Mandatory Requirements, Behavioral Traits, and Structural Factors in the
                    CAP
                    Green Architecture
title_zh: 真正驱动农业-环境-气候措施采纳的因素是什么？CAP绿色架构中的强制性要求、行为特征与结构性因素
authors: L. Sanchez‐Mata, M. Rodríguez‐Entrena, M. Espinosa‐Goded, F. J. Dessart, J. Barreiro‐Hurlé
abstract: ABSTRACT To increase farmer adoption of green practices, the EU Common Agricultural Policy includes both mandatory (conditionality) and voluntary instruments (eco‐schemes–ECS– and more demanding, multi‐annual agri‐environment‐climate measures –AECM–). Building on the experiment of Barreiro‐Hurle et al. (2023), which focused on eco‐schemes, this paper analyses farmers' stated willingness to voluntarily adopt AECM. Using a framed experiment with 600 farmers in Spain, Germany, and Poland, we compared two policy interventions—higher mandatory environmental requirements and an equivalent reduction in income linked to CAP direct payments—and varied their intensity. Higher mandatory environmental requirements and an equivalent income reduction reduce the willingness to voluntarily adopt AECM. We also find a positive conditional association between the intensity of ECS adoption and the willingness to adopt AECM, suggesting potential spillover effects. We further show that behavioral factors, particularly perceived fairness of compensation, environmental concern, confidence in the environmental program, and CAP entitlement, explain substantially more variation in willingness to adopt AECM than standard structural and socio‐demographic characteristics (farm and farmer features). These results have implications for the upcoming envisaged CAP green architecture.
abstract_zh: 摘要 为提升农民对绿色实践的采纳率，欧盟共同农业政策同时包含强制性（条件性）与自愿性工具（生态计划——ECS——以及要求更高、多年期的农业环境气候措施——AECM）。本文基于Barreiro‐Hurle等人（2023）聚焦生态计划的实验研究，进一步分析农民自愿采纳AECM的陈述意愿。通过对西班牙、德国和波兰600名农民开展框架实验，我们比较了两种政策干预——提高强制性环境要求与等额削减CAP直接支付相关的收入——并调整其强度。结果表明，更高的强制性环境要求与等额收入削减均会降低农民自愿采纳AECM的意愿。同时，我们发现ECS采纳强度与AECM采纳意愿之间存在正向条件关联，暗示潜在溢出效应。进一步分析显示，行为因素（尤其是补偿公平感知、环境关切、对环保项目的信心及CAP权益认知）对AECM采纳意愿的解释力显著高于标准的结构性与社会人口特征（农场与农民属性）。这些发现对即将实施的CAP绿色架构具有政策启示。

title: Zoning: Externalities or Misallocation?
title_zh: 分区：外部性还是资源错配？
authors: Yu-Hsin Ho, Chang-Tai Hsieh, Wen-Tai Hsu, Yu-Jhih Luo
official: 官方在线 2026-07-13 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We study how residential-commercial zoning affects the allocation of urban space. Using property-level data from Taipei and 34 U.S. metropolitan areas, we infer neighborhood-level zoning wedges from the allocation of residents, workers, and floor space. We find substantially greater dispersion in these wedges in U.S. cities than in Taipei, where mixed-use development is pervasive. The inferred wedges increase neighborhood specialization and reduce welfare. We then evaluate whether zoning is aligned with the neighborhood characteristics that would justify intervention. Although zoning is systematically related to comparative advantage, comparative advantage explains only a small fraction of the variation in zoning. The dominant effect of zoning in American cities is therefore not to promote efficient land use, but to increase the segregation of residential and commercial activity across neighborhoods.
abstract_zh: 本文研究住宅-商业分区如何影响城市空间的配置。利用台北及美国34个大都市区的房产层面数据，我们从居民、劳动者及楼面空间的配置中推断出社区层面的分区楔子。研究发现，美国城市中这些楔子的离散程度显著高于混合用途开发普遍存在的台北。推断出的楔子加剧了社区专业化并降低了社会福利。随后，我们评估分区是否与可证明干预合理性的社区特征相一致。尽管分区与比较优势存在系统性关联，但比较优势仅能解释分区变化的极小部分。因此，美国城市中分区的主导作用并非促进土地高效利用，而是加剧了住宅与商业活动在社区间的隔离。

title: Capturing Heterogeneity: Machine Learning Approaches to Implied Volatility Forecasting
title_zh: 捕捉异质性：隐含波动率预测的机器学习方法
authors: Hyung Joo Kim, Dong Hwan Oh
official: 官方日期待补 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: Despite documented heterogeneity in volatility dynamics across the option surface, standard implied volatility forecasting models apply homogeneous parameters throughout. We introduce a machine-learning framework that uses regression trees to partition the surface along both moneyness and maturity dimensions, identifying data-driven regions where distinct forecasting models perform best. Extending the Surface Heterogeneous Autoregressive (SHAR) framework of Dufays, Jacobs, and Rombouts (2025), we develop tree-based SHAR specifications that preserve interpretable structure while allowing model parameters to vary across the surface. Empirical analysis using S&P 500 options demonstrates that the boosted tree-based specification achieves the lowest out-of-sample forecast errors across all horizons, reducing one-month-ahead RMSE by 13 percent versus the benchmark SHAR model. The improvements are statistically significant and particularly pronounced during stress periods. The estimated tree presents economically interpretable segmentation: short-dated options exhibit higher daily persistence but lower monthly persistence than long-dated options, while deep out-of-the-money calls or puts display distinct dynamics from near-the-money contracts.
abstract_zh: 尽管期权曲面上的波动率动态存在显著异质性，但标准隐含波动率预测模型在整个曲面上均采用同质参数。我们引入一种基于回归树的机器学习框架，沿期限与执行价两个维度对曲面进行划分，识别出不同预测模型表现最优的数据驱动区域。通过扩展Dufays、Jacobs与Rombouts（2025）提出的曲面异质自回归（SHAR）框架，我们开发了基于树的SHAR模型，在保持可解释结构的同时允许模型参数随曲面位置变化。基于标普500期权的实证分析表明，增强型树模型在所有预测期限上均实现最低的样本外预测误差，将一个月前瞻均方根误差较基准SHAR模型降低13%。该改进具有统计显著性，且在压力时期尤为突出。估计树呈现经济可解释的分段特征：短期期权较长期期权具有更高的日度持续性但更低的月度持续性，而深度虚值看涨/看跌期权则展现出与平值期权截然不同的动态特征。

title: An Analytical Model of Behavior and Policy in an Epidemic
title_zh: 流行病中行为与政策的分析模型
official: 来源期次 American Economic Journal: Macroeconomics · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This paper examines the behavior of individuals susceptible to a deadly disease in a tractable equilibrium setting. We analytically characterize individually optimal mitigation behavior and the resulting equilibrium trajectory. Analysis is facilitated by a phase diagram. A key insight is that individually optimal behavior of those susceptible to the disease results in excessive caution. This behavior flattens the epidemic curve and prolongs the epidemic. In contrast, socially optimal behavior results in a higher infection rate, with a focus on minimizing cumulative deaths at minimum cost. The paper offers novel technical contributions and an improved understanding of externalities in econ-epi models. (JEL D62, D91, I12, I18)
abstract_zh: 本文在一个易于处理的均衡框架下，研究了易感致命疾病个体的行为。我们通过解析方法刻画了个体最优的缓解行为及其导致的均衡轨迹，并借助相图进行分析。核心发现是：易感个体的最优行为会导致过度谨慎，这种平缓了流行病曲线，却延长了疫情持续时间。相比之下，社会最优行为会带来更高的感染率，其核心目标是以最小成本最小化累计死亡人数。本文在技术层面提出创新，并深化了对经济-流行病模型中外部性的理解。（JEL D62, D91, I12, I18）

title: Order Effects and Teacher Labor Supply: A Nationwide RCT in Ecuador
title_zh: 顺序效应与教师劳动力供给：厄瓜多尔的一项全国性随机对照试验
authors: Nicolás Ajzenman, Gregory Elacqua, Luana Marotta, Anne Sofie Olsen
official: 来源期次 American Economic Journal: Applied Economics · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We evaluate a nationwide zero-cost intervention to reduce teacher sorting, where lower-income students are more likely to attend understaffed schools with less qualified teachers. Our approach was grounded in an insight from behavioral economics known as order effects. In the treatment arm, the teacher job application platform showed hard-to-staff schools first, while, in the control group, schools were displayed alphabetically. Treated teachers were more likely to apply to hard-to-staff schools, ranking them their highest priority. Inattentive or less qualified teachers did not influence the results. The intervention helped to reduce the unequal distribution of qualified teachers across schools. (JEL D91, I23, I24, J28, J45, O15)
abstract_zh: 我们评估了一项全国性的零成本干预措施，旨在减少教师分配不均问题——低收入家庭学生更可能就读于师资短缺、教师资质较差的学校。该干预措施基于行为经济学中的“顺序效应”洞见。在实验组中，教师求职平台优先展示师资紧缺学校，而对照组则按字母顺序排列学校。受干预的教师更倾向于申请师资紧缺学校，并将其列为最高优先级。注意力不集中或资质较差的教师并未影响结果。该干预措施有助于缩小合格教师在学校间的不均衡分布。（JEL分类号：D91, I23, I24, J28, J45, O15）

title: Bayesian Model Averaging in Causal Instrumental Variable Models
title_zh: 因果工具变量模型中的贝叶斯模型平均
abstract: ABSTRACT Instrumental variables are a popular tool to infer causal effects under unobserved confounding, but choosing suitable instruments is challenging in practice. We propose gIVBMA, a Bayesian model averaging procedure that addresses this challenge by averaging across different sets of instrumental variables and covariates in a structural equation model. This allows for data‐driven selection of valid and relevant instruments and provides additional robustness against invalid instruments. Our approach extends previous work through a scale‐invariant prior structure and accommodates non‐Gaussian outcomes and treatments, offering greater flexibility than existing methods. The computational strategy uses conditional Bayes factors to update models separately for the outcome and treatments. We prove that this model selection procedure is consistent. In simulation experiments, gIVBMA outperforms current state‐of‐the‐art methods. We demonstrate its usefulness in two empirical applications: the effects of malaria and institutions on income per capita and the returns to schooling. A software implementation of gIVBMA is available in Julia.
